measured: A/A noise: Render bench run 42196735742 (bench/670-noise, ubuntu-24.04, 5 rounds, self-a vs self-b); Close prompt: run 42338764501 (bench/986-close-prompt-noise, same setup); A/B: run 42196737507 (bench/670, v0.1.2 vs candidate). See docs/render-bench.md. Long-task time, the ungated main busy at 50 panes and the unpaced drawn bytes per second (#844): A/A run 42328540413 (bench/844-gates-noise), A/B run 42328540737 (bench/844-gates, against v0.1.5, whose web code is the candidate's).

frameP95.why: A/A medians moved 0.1 ms at 1, 15 and 50 panes; intervals step by one 60 Hz frame (16.7 ms), the limit is 1.25x the baseline (that term is the larger above 16 ms), so a one-frame shift of the median fails at baselines of 50 ms or less and may pass above that (docs/render-bench.md)

busyShare.why: A/A medians moved at most 0.017; a share cannot pass 1, so where the limit does (50 panes, already 97-98% busy) the row is reported ungated and long-task time gates instead (#844)

longTaskMs.why: 50 panes: A/A medians 1580 / 1370 ms (rounds 1160 to 2173), and two builds with the same web code (v0.1.5 and the candidate) 1521 / 2198 ms, 1.45x; 0 at 1 and 15 panes. 2x fails #842's 756 to 1,695 ms (2.24x) and passes that spread (docs/render-bench.md)

catchUpMs.why: read at a 50 ms poll, so runs land near 5 or 55 ms; A/A medians moved 41 ms at 15 panes

drawnBytesPerSec.why: unpaced phase (#844): A/A medians moved 7.5% at 1 pane (single rounds 774 to 884 KiB/s), 1.4% at 15 and 0.5% at 50

heapMB.why: read after a full garbage collection (#1037): A/A rounds within 0.6 MB at every pane count (run 42306731684); read without one it moved about 30 MB between runs of one build

showCatchUpMs.why: A/A medians moved 178 ms at 50 panes

closePromptMs.why: #560's budget: the median click may not pass 200 ms, whatever the baseline measured. A/A medians on ubuntu-24.04 (run 42338764501, 5 rounds): 9.4 / 9.5 ms at 1 pane, 22.2 / 22.5 at 15, 76.3 / 65.1 at 50 (runs' medians 55 to 80, single clicks 46 to 111), so 200 is 2.6x the release runner's 50-pane median; on a loaded Linux host 16.2 / 16.8, 29.7 / 37.1 and 142.5 / 107.3 (runs' medians 83 to 186). The medians moved 1.33x at most, so 1.5x and 50 ms above the baseline (docs/render-bench.md)
